Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.desktop.audio

Enum Class SoundEffect

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<SoundEffect>
com.epitech.depthdiablo.desktop.audio.SoundEffect
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<SoundEffect>, Constable
public enum SoundEffect extends Enum<SoundEffect>
The short sound effects of the game (GDD 4.2), each loaded whole into memory from sounds/<file>.ogg so it plays with no delay. Two effects may share a file. The music loop is not here: it streams (GDD 4.3). Each effect has its own volume, so a loud file can be turned down without editing it.
